Issued at 09:00 PM 05 November 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #NorthCotabato(Alamada, Banisilan, Midsayap, Aleosan, Carmen, Pikit), #MaguindanaoDelNorte(Parang, Buldon, SultanKudarat, Barira, SultanMastura, Kabuntalan, Talitay, DatuOdinSinsuat), #SurigaoDelSur(Cantilan, Madrid, Carmen, Lanuza, Cortes, Carrascal), #ZamboangaSibugay(Mabuhay, Talusan), #SultanKudarat(Isulan, Bagumbayan, Sen.NinoyAquino, Esperanza), #DavaoDelNorte(CityOfSamal, Carmen, CityOfPanabo), #MaguindanaoDelSur(DatuPiang, DatuAnggalMidtimbang, Pagagawan, Pagalungan), #CotabatoCity, #TawiTawi(PanglimaSugala, SapaSapa and Languyan) within the next 1-2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #NorthCotabato(Pigkawayan, Libungan) and #MaguindanaoDelNorte(NorthernKabuntalan) which may persist within 1-2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
